description: Approved revision to zaq-354 on current uncommitted branch. Shared channel/thread history with author provenance; person-bound runtimes and credentials; explicit source-aware grants on channel resources inherited by threads; provider membership grant synchronization infrastructure but downstream provider events deferred; email excluded from membership removal; BO list/detail and People access UI; delivery correctness. Preserve old private history without merging. Capture all messages, only mentions trigger channel responses. Action reuse: extend Engine Conversations, Permissions, Channels/Agent APIs; new validated refresh Action is prerequisite to BO/agent/workflow consumers, never auto-expose as an agent tool. TDD each step; isolated tests + mix q; human UX approval then consolidated E2E, final mix precommit.

comments.text: Dependency graph: grants+identity → transcript → authorized projection → runtime fanout → runtime revocation → validation; grants+identity → membership refresh → revocation/People UI; transcript → BO history UI; independent final-delivery fix → validation; BO/People UI → human approval → consolidated E2E. Existing zaq-354 was prematurely closed before these user acceptance changes; this follow-up tracks revision. Provider events/adapter wiring deferred until downstream JidoChat projects land. User authorized reusing unconsumed migration files and preserving dirty worktree after rebase.

Progress: source-aware permission rows/channel resource with direct-Person read gate, ordered status edits, BO list/detail channel/thread identifier display are implemented and focused-tested. Core approved revision is NOT yet complete: connector-scoped author mapping, shared multi-author transcript/passive capture, authorized root+parent hydration, person runtime fanout, membership refresh/revocation, People UI, migration, coverage/E2E, and final precommit remain open. User explicitly approved migration linking existing identities to sole provider connector and extending existing UI without prototype. No commit/push; preserve original uncommitted issue768 files.
